data.message: Heading security for cameras, then storage. Bob, want to stick together?

I found Alice’s body in Weapons. My route was Electrical -> Medbay -> back to Electrical -> Security -> Weapons. 

Early on I saw Charlie in Electrical around ticks 2-4. Then I saw Diana enter Medbay from Upper Engine around tick 7, and she was still in Medbay tick 8. After that I went through Security into Weapons and found Alice dead there. I didn’t see anyone else in Weapons when I reported.

I can confirm Eve and I were in Electrical together early, around ticks 2-4. After that I went through Security down toward Navigation for my task — I didn’t see anyone else on that side, and I never saw Alice alive or the body.

Eve’s route sounds possible to me, but since the body was in Weapons, I’d really like to hear where Bob and Frank were. Diana being in Medbay around tick 7-8 also seems away from Weapons unless she moved fast after that.

My route was Oxygen -> Upper Engine -> Medbay -> Electrical. I never went to Weapons and I never saw Alice this round.

I can confirm part of Eve’s story: I saw Eve in Medbay around tick 7, and then I saw her leave Medbay toward Electrical at tick 8. Bob came into Medbay from Upper Engine around tick 10, then I saw him enter Electrical from Medbay around tick 13, and he was still with me in Electrical at tick 14 when the meeting got called.

So Bob was with/near me late, and Eve’s movement through Medbay/Electrical checks out from what I saw. I didn’t see Frank at all. Charlie was apparently on the Security/Navigation side, which is closer to Weapons, so I want to hear Bob and Frank’s routes before deciding.

I started in Security, went down to Navigation, then across through Storage to Lower Engine. I didn’t see anyone the whole round, and I never went into Weapons or saw Alice alive.

From what’s been said, Eve and Diana are backing each other up around Medbay/Electrical, and Diana says Bob was with her late in Electrical. Charlie’s route puts him on the Security/Navigation side, which is the closest path to Weapons, but I can’t confirm or deny him because I didn’t see him when I passed through that area.

I’d like to hear Bob’s full route before voting. Right now I don’t have enough to hard accuse — Charlie is the only one whose claimed area is near the body, but that’s not proof.

My route was Lower Engine -> Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> back through Upper Engine -> Medbay -> Electrical. I never went to Weapons and I never saw Alice this round.

I can confirm Diana’s general route: I saw Diana leave Oxygen toward Upper Engine around tick 4, then I saw her again in Medbay around tick 10, and we were together/near each other in Electrical late. Small correction: I saw Diana leave Electrical toward Security right before the report, around tick 14, but I don’t think she could’ve reached Weapons and killed before Eve reported.

So Diana’s story checks out to me, and Eve’s Medbay/Electrical timing also seems supported by Diana. I’m not suspicious of Diana here, and I think I’m pretty clear from being on the left side then with Diana late.

The main uncertainty is the right side. Charlie says he went Security/Navigation, Frank says he was Security -> Navigation -> Storage -> Lower Engine, but they didn’t see each other, and Weapons is right above that area. Eve could technically be self-reporting, but her route has some confirmation. I don’t think we have enough for a hard vote, but if we do vote, Charlie/Frank are the only routes that don’t really get confirmed and are near Weapons. I’d lean skip unless someone has stronger timing.

I’ll restate the key point from my side: I found Alice dead in Weapons, and I saw nobody else in the room when I reported.

My confirmed route was Electrical -> Medbay -> back through Electrical -> Security -> Weapons. Charlie can confirm I was in Electrical early, and Diana confirms seeing me in Medbay around tick 7-8 before I went back toward Electrical/Security.

After hearing everyone, I’m less suspicious of Diana and Bob because their timings line up with each other and put them away from Weapons late. That leaves Charlie and Frank as the least confirmed people on the right side near Security/Navigation/Weapons. I don’t have a hard accusation, though — being nearby isn’t enough by itself.

So my suspicion is mostly between Charlie and Frank, but unless someone has stronger timing, I’m okay with a skip rather than risking a bad vote.

I’m still saying skip is safest unless people want to force between me and Frank.

My side: I was in Electrical with Eve early, then went right through Security and down to Navigation. I was in Navigation when the report happened. I didn’t see Alice at all and I didn’t see the body.

The part that worries me is Frank saying he started Security -> Navigation, because if our timings overlapped I feel like one of us should’ve seen the other on that side. Maybe we just missed each other, but that’s the only thing that stands out to me.

Eve/Diana/Bob all have some cross-confirming on the left/center, so I get why the suspicion is on right side. I know it wasn’t me, so if we’re not skipping I’d be more suspicious of Frank, but I don’t think we have enough hard proof.

I want to correct one thing from Bob: I don’t think I left Electrical toward Security before the report. From my perspective I was still in Electrical with Bob around tick 14 when the meeting got called.

My info is the same: Oxygen -> Upper Engine -> Medbay -> Electrical. I saw Eve in Medbay around tick 7, then she left toward Electrical at tick 8. Bob came into Medbay from Upper Engine around tick 10, then later came into Electrical from Medbay around tick 13 and was there with me late.

That makes Bob pretty unlikely for the Weapons kill timing-wise, and Eve’s route is at least partly confirmed by me. I agree the main unresolved area is Charlie/Frank on the right side, especially since both claim Security/Navigation-ish routes but didn’t see each other. But I don’t think we have enough to confidently vote one over the other.

I’m leaning skip for now, but next round I’d watch Charlie and Frank closely.

I don’t have much new, but to defend my route: I really did go Security -> Navigation -> Storage -> Lower Engine, and I never went up into Weapons. I didn’t see Charlie, but if he came through Security after me or stayed in Navigation after I’d already left toward Storage, that could explain the miss.

From everyone’s stories, Bob and Diana are mostly paired up late and away from Weapons, and Eve’s Medbay/Electrical timing has some confirmation before she reports. That still leaves me and Charlie as the least confirmed near the right side, but the only evidence is “nearby,” not an actual contradiction.

I agree with Diana here: I’m leaning skip rather than risking voting wrong. Next round, people should keep eyes on me and Charlie if they’re worried, and we should try to pair up more so this doesn’t happen again.

My route was Lower Engine -> Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> back through Upper Engine -> Medbay -> Electrical. I never went to Weapons and never saw Alice.

I saw Diana leave Oxygen toward Upper Engine around tick 4, then I saw her again in Medbay around tick 10. Late round I was in Electrical with Diana, and from what I saw she moved toward Security right before the report, around tick 14. Even with that, I don’t think the timing makes her likely for a Weapons kill before Eve reported.

So for me, Diana seems pretty clear, and Eve’s route has some confirmation from Charlie early and Diana around Medbay. The unresolved part is still Charlie and Frank: both were on or near the Security/Navigation side, close to Weapons, and they didn’t see each other despite overlapping claims.

I don’t think we have enough to confidently choose between Charlie and Frank, though. My vote is probably skip unless someone has a stronger reason. Next round we should keep eyes on those two and pair up more.

I reported Frank’s body in medbay. Bob is also dead in electrical.

My route this round was: medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage → back to medbay, where I found Frank.

Sightings: I saw Charlie in electrical around ticks 2-4, and Bob’s body is in electrical, so Charlie needs to explain that. I saw Diana in medbay around ticks 7-8, and then again entering medbay from cafeteria at tick 16. Frank’s body was in medbay, so Diana also needs to explain her timing there.

I’m not locking yet, but with only Charlie and Diana alive besides me, it’s between them from my POV.

Eve, your timeline on me doesn’t really make sense. Yeah, you saw me in electrical at ticks 2-4, but Bob was alive much later than that — I saw him in electrical around tick 18. So using my early electrical timing for Bob’s body feels like a stretch.

My route was security → electrical briefly → medbay/engines area → storage/lower/upper → oxygen. I did see Frank moving from upper engine into medbay around tick 22-24, but I wasn’t staying in medbay with him. If Frank died there, that points more toward whoever was cycling through medbay after that.

The bigger thing for me: Eve is reporting Frank in medbay and also somehow has info that Bob’s body is in electrical. That means Eve’s route intersects both dead-body locations. Diana also apparently had medbay timing, so I’m not clearing her, but Eve framing me off a super early sighting while Bob was alive later feels off.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → storage → navigation → security → weapons. I saw Eve in medbay around tick 7, and Bob was alive in medbay around tick 10, then I saw Bob alive in electrical around ticks 13-14.

I did **not** go back into medbay around tick 16 like Eve said — after medbay I went storage/nav/security/weapons and stayed away from medbay. So Eve placing me back at Frank’s body area is wrong.

Charlie’s point also makes sense: Eve using an early Charlie-in-electrical sighting to pin Bob doesn’t fit if Bob was alive later, and I can confirm Bob was alive in electrical after that early window.

From my POV, Eve’s report hits both body locations, her timeline on Charlie is shaky, and she falsely puts me back in medbay. I think Eve is the duck here.

I’ll correct my own earlier point: Charlie being in electrical at ticks 2-4 is not enough by itself if Bob was alive later. I’m not going to pretend that’s a lock.

But Diana, I absolutely saw you enter medbay from cafeteria at tick 16. That is in my observations, and you’re flat-out denying it. That’s the hardest contradiction in this meeting.

Charlie’s story has some vagueness, but Diana is the one directly denying a medbay sighting near the Frank body area. From my POV, I’m the reporter, I know I’m not the duck, and Diana’s denial makes her look the worst.

I’m leaning Eve here. The big red flag is still that Eve reported Frank in medbay but opened with “Bob is also dead in electrical” even though her claimed route doesn’t go back through electrical at all. How does she know that location?

Also, Eve first tried to pin Bob on me from ticks 2-4 electrical, then backed off when both Diana and I said Bob was alive much later. That feels like throwing suspicion and adjusting when challenged.

Diana’s route at least lines up with what she’s saying, and she independently confirms Bob alive after Eve’s early electrical sighting. Eve is the one connecting herself to both body locations/info and falsely placing people near bodies. I think we vote Eve.

I’m sticking with Eve.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → storage → navigation → security → weapons. I saw Eve in medbay around tick 7, Bob alive in medbay around tick 10, and then Bob alive in electrical around ticks 13-14. I never went back to medbay after leaving for storage/nav/security/weapons, so Eve saying she saw me enter medbay from cafeteria at tick 16 is just false.

Charlie’s early electrical sighting can’t explain Bob if Bob was alive later, and Eve only backed off that after being challenged. Plus Eve somehow knew Bob was dead in electrical while reporting Frank in medbay, and her claimed route doesn’t explain that. She’s also the one falsely placing me near Frank’s body.

With three of us left, we can’t afford a bad vote. I think the duck is Eve.
